text: A progressive key slides the secret word along the table by a fixed step, after every letter or after every pass of the word, as some cipher machines (Kryha) did. Only part of this had been tried.
Every step 1-25 and word length 1-52, both kinds of stepping, on 1,040,314 tables (the sculpture's and every dictionary word's), against the 24 known letters and ten scrambled copies.
Nothing fits below length 25, on K4 as on the copies; K4 leads the copies in 4 of 104 cells, within what a copy manages against the rest. Length 34 noted.
